name: panko-gpt
description: AI Bot Platform - Easy GPT bot creation for Whatsapp, Discord, Telegram and soon other platforms. Features: Vector Search (RAG), Easy management via UI.

variables.name: MONGO_ATLAS_PUBLIC_KEY
variables.description: You can use the free tier from MongoDB Atlas

variables.name: MONGO_ATLAS_PRIVATE_KEY
variables.description: IMPORTANT: Ensure the API Keys have 'Organization Owner' permissions (tutorial how to obtain these keys: https://tinyurl.com/25tesjpn)

variables.name: MONGO_ATLAS_PROJECT_ID
variables.description: You can find the Project ID in the url after you log into the atlas cloud account and selecting the project. e.g. https://cloud.mongodb.com/v2/PROJECT_ID_HERE#/overview

variables.name: MONGO_ATLAS_CLUSTER_NAME
variables.description: e.g. the name of the cluster you set when you first created the MongoDB account

variables.name: MONGO_ATLAS_DB_NAME
variables.description: (Optional) if not specified, pankogpt will be used

variables.name: GLOBAL_OPEN_AI_KEY
variables.description: (Optional) but recommended to help pull certain info like all available models
